description: size getter: fast-path condition inverted from !this.#size to this.#size, so the raw #oldCache.size is returned whenever #size > 0 instead of running the dedup guard loop. Gap: the fp-10 size test (maxSize:3 scenario) has #size=1 and #oldCache={a,c} (2 keys); with the inverted condition, it returns this.#oldCache.size=2, which matches the expected value 2 and the test passes.
productionImpact: Whenever #size is non-zero (i.e., on every non-empty cache access), size returns the raw #oldCache.size, which double-counts any key that was promoted to #cache while still in #oldCache. Applications enforcing capacity limits or triggering eviction from the .size property will see an inflated count, causing premature eviction loops or accepting items past the declared maxSize.
